// A circle fitted to points in the plane, with its residual statistics.
// Residuals are radial: the distance from each sample to the circle itself,
// not to its centre. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circle_fitting)
type CircleFit2D
    implements IValue, IFitted
{
    Circle: Circle;
    Quality: FitQuality;
}
